protocol.hypothesis: A past-only liquidity sweep followed within 1 or 3 completed bars by a same-direction fair value gap may improve calendar-year and monthly outcomes relative to either event alone.

untested_dependencies: FVG retracement entry rather than immediate next open

protocol.parameter_rationale: Two lookbacks (10,20), two ATR sweep depths (0,0.25), two minimum FVG sizes (0,0.2 ATR), and two causal confirmation windows (1,3 bars) form all 16 combinations plus 6 standalone controls; 23 variants including buy-and-hold. This is a bounded hypothesis, not all Smart Money Concepts.
protocol.baseline: 25% long buy-and-hold on the same execution candles with next-open fill and identical modeled costs; independent sweep-only and FVG-only controls use the same exit.
protocol.signal_rule: At completed bar i, long sweep: low_i below minimum low of preceding N completed bars by more than sweep_atr * ATR14_i and close_i back above that minimum; short symmetric. Bullish FVG: low_i above high_(i-2) by more than fvg_atr * ATR14_i; bearish symmetric. Combined long/short signal occurs only on an FVG bar when same-direction sweep occurred in preceding 1 or 3 completed bars. Standalone controls enter at sweep/FVG bar. All enter next bar open. A position exits next open after close beyond prior 10-bar opposite extreme; opposing entry also closes it. ATR uses only bars through i. No order blocks or institutional order flow are inferred.
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Compare full-universe calendar-year and monthly medians of each combination against sweep-only, FVG-only and buy-and-hold; research only. No paper promotion until data quality, parity and costs are reviewed.
limitations: SMC is a broad visual vocabulary; this run tests only one mechanical sweep-then-FVG interpretation
Signals are based on completed OHLC bars; intrabar path is unknown
Corporate actions, borrow fees and exchange lots are not fully modeled

validation.note: DATA_READY confirms data and report gates only; it does not approve a trading strategy.

blockers: Заявленные 16 сочетаний sweep + FVG не дали убедительного результата на полном наборе после модельных расходов. Лучшая медиана среднемесячной доходности сочетания: 1H -0.10%, 4H около 0%, 1D +0.08% на 263/263/252 акциях соответственно; годовые медианы в отчёте низкие, многие 1D сочетания дают нулевой результат из-за редких сигналов. Автоматический кандидат fvg_0.2 4H — отдельный контроль с ранней медианой -0.01% за месяц, не подтверждение комбинированной гипотезы.

decision.note: Закрыта только указанная механическая трактовка Smart Money. Это не проверка всех order blocks, структуры рынка или входа на возврате в FVG. Исторические дивиденды, сплиты и стоимость займа short не полностью учтены.
